tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// sman bla'i mdo chog gzhan phan bde 'jug gi zur rgyan kun phan ut+pal gzhon nu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+ye/ mkhyen brtse byams pa'i 'od dkar bla bre de// kun dga'i chos dbyings mkha' la bshams pa las// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i yang gsang kun+da'i nags// spel mkhas rgyal sras mtshan mo'i mgon der 'dud// rgyal ba'i mtshan dbyangs nor bu ke ta ka /gang zhig dri bcas kun gzhi'i mtshor lhung bas// gang dag zag bcas rnyog ma bgrung mdzad pa// bcom ldan bde gshegs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// gang de rnams kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags la// mngon par brten pa'i nad gdon nyer 'tshe dang*// sdug bsngal tshogs rnams sbyong byed cho ga yi// zur rgyan ut+pal gzhon nu'i 'khri shing 'bri// de la'ang 'dir sman bla'i mdo chog snying po gzhan phan bde 'jug la brten nas/ sdig sbyong dang*/ 'chi bslu/ gshin po rjes 'dzin bcas bya tshul bklag chog tu bkod pa la/ dang po ni/ mdo chog tu gsal ba ltar cho ga 'di'i sngon du theg chen gso sbyong zhig nges par len dgos par bshad cing*/ ci ste ma grub kyang sha chang*/ sgog btsong sogs kyi dris ma spags pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pas sbyor ba'i chos rnams tshang bar byas shing*/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs yul rnams gsal btab nas cho ga gzhung du/ rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs/ zhes sogs skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces pa'i bar dkyus ltar nyams su blang zhing*/ 'on kyang gzungs sngags bzla ba'i dus su dmigs pa ni/ rang gis sngags bzlas pas de'i dus su sman bla mched brgyad kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas bum pa'i nang thams cad gang ba'i mos pa brtan por byas nas gzungs sngags gong 'og gsum ka ci nus bzla zhing*/ gal te long ma byung na gzungs chen dang gzungs ring lan bdun tsam dang*/

de nas gzungs thung la bzlas tshad bzung bas chog cing*/ gang ltar yang mjug chog gtang rag gi mgor slebs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi sdig sbyang bya rgyu'i yon bdag sogs sha chang sgog btsong gis kha dris ma sbags pa gos rgyan sogs kyis brgyan nas rang gi mdun du 'khod du bcug nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod/ 'o 'dir mtshan tsam thos pas sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar nus pa snyigs ma'i mgon po ston pa bde gshegs brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i lad mo mdzod/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas par ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar bcug nas/ spro zhing nus na blo sgo dang mthun pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang*/ phan yon rnams rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa spyi 'gre ltar skabs dang bstun nas bshad nus na legs/ ma grub kyang skyon med/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ khyed rang rnams la gzungs khrus byed pa'i sngon du bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la sku khrus gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod nas mchod g.yog pas rten la me long bstan zhing de'i ngos la sngags kyi dus su khrus gsol ba dang bcas pas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/

bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// ces dang*/ rol mo bya zhing de'i bar du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra marda na/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bodhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod sprin gyi gzungs 'di tshar gcig brjod pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ ye dharmā sogs rten 'brel snying po brjod kyang chog ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// rol mo bya zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gong bzhin nam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// mchod gnas rin chen khyed rnams la// bdag cag dad pas sku khrus gsol// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gong bzhin nam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ ༈ /rnam dag skyon bral byang chub sems kyi dbyings// rnam dag skyon bral yon tan tshogs kyi gter// kun gyis phyag byas bstod cing mchod pa'i gnas// bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams ma lus tshar gcod phyir// chos dbyings dag pa'i sku la khrus chab gsol// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rtog pa dag gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ rnam dag skyon bral byang chub sems kyi dbyings// rnam dag skyon bral yon tan tshogs kyi gter// kun gyis phyag byas bstod cing mchod pa'i gnas// bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams ma lus tshar gcod phyir// chos dbyings dag pa'i gsung la khrus chab gsol// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rtog pa dag gyur cig

/oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ rnam dag skyon bral byang chub sems kyi dbyings// rnam dag skyon bral yon tan tshogs kyi gter// kun gyis phyag byas bstod cing mchod pa'i gnas// bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams ma lus tshar gcod phyir// chos dbyings dag pa'i thugs la khrus chab gsol// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rtog pa dag gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sam/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ de lta bus gong ma rnams rol mo'i bar la mchod sprin gyi gzungs sam rten 'brel snying po ci rigs 'don pa las/ sngags gzhung nas byung ba lta bu'i khrus dang mchod pa'i sngags gzhan 'don pa ni mdo chog dang rigs mi 'brel zhing bshad khungs yang khungs btsun med pas mi legs shing mdo chog dngos gtsang du yang mi 'gyur ro// de nas ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas sku phyi ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ bde gshegs sku gsum dpe dang mtshan mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'// rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*// 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du// sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i// ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas// nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// sku gsum ngang du bdag cag myur 'grub shog /ces dang*/ yang sku la byug pa 'bul tshul gyis/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// bde gshegs brgyad la snam sbyar sogs na bza' ngur smrig 'bul bar mos te/

dri med mtshan la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /'khor rnams la na bza' phul bar mos te/ lha rdzas las byung kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong ldan// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs pa// 'jam dpal skyabs grol sogs la dbul bar bgyi// rgyan 'bul bar mos te/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /mchod pa'i bye brag yo byad 'bul bar mos te/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*// ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rgyan 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di// sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang ste phul ba yis// las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun byang nas// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces brjod pa'i mthar mchod g.yog pas sku khrus gsol ba'i chu de bum par blugs la sngon gnas su bzhag slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod/ 'o lags/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma bai ḍūr+ya'i gzungs 'di'i phan yon ni 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ de yang mdo las rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'di 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod dam/ lan stong rtsa brgyad du bton na de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems par 'gyur/

rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyis yang dag par bsrung bar 'gyur/ lha thams cad dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gis kyang yongs su skyong bar 'gyur/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ nad thams cad kyis mi 'debs par 'gyur/ ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ 'chi ba dang*/ dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dgra thams cad kyi dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ ci bsams pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i don la mos pa brtan por mdzad nas gzungs kyi khrus byas pas nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad lhag med du dag song snyam du mdzod/ ces brjod mthar/ tad+ya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ i mi ni mi hi/ ma ti ma ti/ sap+ta ta thā ga ta/ sa madh+yā dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ a te ma te/ pā le pā paṃ/ sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ na sha ya ma ma bud+dhe bud+dhot+ta me/ u me ku me/ bud+dha k+ṣe tra pa ri shodha ni/ dha me ni dha me/ me ru me ru me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu/ ni pā ra ṇi/ bud+dhe su bud+dhe/ bud+dha adhiṣ+ṭhā na rak+ṣan+tu me/ sarba de ba sa me a sa me sa ma n+wā hā ran+tu/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa/ sha me sha me/ pra sha man+tu me/ sarba it+yu pa dra ba byā dha ya/ pū ra ṇe pū ra ṇe pū ra ya me/ sar+b+ba ā sha ya/ baiḍūr+ya pra ti bhā se sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ zhes gzungs chen dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyas+k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣadz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā sa mut+ga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā sa mut+ga te swā hā/

zhes gzungs thung ste sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rims thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ gdon thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad= 'khon thams cad= grib thams cad= byad thams cad= byur thams cad= skal ba ngan pa thams cad= ltas ngan pa thams cad= mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad= rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= bkra mi shis pa thams cad= mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon thams cad= dus kyi zhags pa thams cad= gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bkru/ yang rma bya'i sgros byabs nas/ gzungs kyi mthar che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā nas/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar sngags bsgyur pa tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin brjod pas byabs/ yang bsrung ba ni gzungs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes pa nas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥzhes pa'i bar sngags sgyur ba tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin brjod cing*/ sngags kyi tshe bsrung bya'i spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas bsrung*/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla mched brgyad kyi mtshan dang gzungs la brten pa'i gzungs khrus kyi rim pa mdo nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin legs par phul grub pa lags pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab nas bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su btang ste mjug chog gtang rag gi phyag mchod 'bul ba man chad mdo chog tu gsal ba ltar bya'o/

༈ /gnyis pa 'chi bslu ni/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor ram blos bslang gi mthar mar me tshan pa bzhi bcu zhe dgu 'byor na rab/ de ltar ma 'byor na nyung mtha' yang tshan pa bdun nges par dgos shing*/ de bzhin du dar sna lnga'i ba dan dngos su 'byor na rab/ ma 'byor tshe ras skud sna lnga lta bus ba dan gyi tshul du byas pa ci 'byor bshams zhing*/ dngos gzhi gso sbyong len par nus na dang*/ ci ste ma nus na skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces pa'i bar gyi sman bla'i mdo chog dkyus bzhin yongs rdzogs dang*/ de nas bsgrub bya gang yod de rang gi mdun du 'khod du bcug cing slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ 'dir mtshan tsam thos pas sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar nus pa zhes pa nas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes byabs pa'i bar gong gi sdig sbyong gi skabs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin tshang bar byas te/ de nas 'chi bslu dngos ni/ nad pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar khang hrul nang nas bsdus pa'i bong ba kham bu tsam nyer gcig 'jag ma sor bzhi pa nyer gcig zan gyi mar me'i ting lo nyer gcig chu phor pa gang bcas bkod/ de rnams la oṃ tha gu na gu da gu swā hā/ che ge mo'i tshe la gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas la chu phor nang du gdab/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ snyigs ma'i mgon po ston pa bde bar gshegs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs pa srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis che ge mo'i nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig

ces brjod la khrus byas pa'i chu dang lhan gcig rdzas de rnams lam sum mdo'am gnod phyogs su dor ba dang mnyam du 'di skad brjod/ oṃ tha gu na gu da gu swā hā/ che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i lo sri/ zla sri/ zhag sri/ dus sri/ che sri/ chung sri/ rgan sri/ gzhon sri/ dar sri thams cad zlog cig lo rgyal po'i keg zla ba blon po'i keg zhag dmag mi'i keg dus tshod mtshon cha'i keg bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba/ ma mo'i dal yams zug pa/ sngags pa'i phur bus btab pa/ ban bon gyis ngan byed dmod zor 'phen pa la sogs pa thams cad bong ba bzhin du khyer cig mar me bzhin du chus sod cig 'jag ma bzhin du chus khyer cig chag che ba/ nyam nga ba/ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad med par gyur cig brlag par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod cing thal mo lan gsum brdab/ de nas bsgrub bya rnams stan gsar pa la bzhag ste/ gong bzhin sman bla'i gzungs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥnas/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes brjod la lus kyi spyi bo/ mdun rgyab/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis su rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bzhag nas bsrung ba byas nas/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman bla mched brgyad kyi gzungs khrus dang rjes su 'brel ba'i 'chi bslu rim pa rnams mdo las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin legs par grub zin pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di sogs bsngo smon brjod nas bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su btang*/ rjes gtang rag gi phyag mchod bya ba man chad dkyus bzhin bya'o//

༈ /gsum pa gshin po rjes 'dzin ni/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor bshams mchod thams cad mdo chog ltar dang*/ gshin po gang yin de'i gzugs kyi rten nam/ ming yig gang 'os dang*/ de'i mdun du sbyong chas gtor ma dang*/ til rnams bsham/ dngos gzhi theg chen gso sbyong len pa'am/ ma nus na skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog ces pa'i bar mdo chog dkyus ltar cho ga ma tshang ba med pa grub par byas nas gshin chog dngos gzhi la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du deng 'dir pho brang mchis pa tsam la brten nas bde bar gshegs pa brgyad spyan drangs pa'i zhabs 'bring du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang pho brang gi slad rol du mchis nas gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du thal mo sbyar te tsog pur 'khod par gyur cig ces gsal legs par btab nas/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ snyigs ma'i mgon po ston pa bde bar gshegs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs pa srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug srid pa bar do gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod de/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa nā ya hūm̐/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa a thung gi rnam par bkug pa de nyid rten 'di la thim par gyur zhes dang*/ de nas gtor ma la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod nas bsngos la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la sogs pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad la sbyin no// gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la gtor ma dor ba las 'di mdo lugs yin pas zhi drag gi sbyang ba gzhan mi sbyor/ de nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam pas sna sgo nas thon te sdig pa ra can gyi rnam pas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid mer bsregs shing chur dor bar gyur/ ces brjod nas g.yas su me dang g.yon du chur dor bas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas me chu phyir dor/ de nas sman bla'i gzungs gong 'og gsum ka'am/ de tsam ma nus na gzungs ring thung gnyis brgya rtsa'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas pa'i bye ma'am/ yungs kar gyis rten la na mo bha ga wa te tshar gsum gyis brab nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas sman bla'i dkyil 'khor ram/ pho brang gi ngos la me long bstan te sngags kyi tshe khrus gsol ba dang bcas te/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ yar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod sprin gyi gzungs sngags 'di rol mo'i bar du brjod cing ma nus na ye dharmā brjod kyang chog 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol par mdzod// oṃ na mo bha ga ba te sogs gong bzhin mchod sprin gyi gzungs sam ye dharmā brjod/ rgyal ba'i sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das lus kyi dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gong bzhin brjod/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das ngag gi dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga sogs gong bzhin brjod/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das yid kyi dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ na mo bha ga sogs gong bzhin brjod/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gong bzhin mchod sprin gyi gzungs sam ye dharmā brjod/ de nas ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas sku phyi ba'i tshul bya zhing*/

bde gshegs sku gsum dpe dang mtshan mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'// rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*// 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du// sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i// ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas// nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// sku gsum ngang du bdag cag myur 'grub shog /ces dang*/ yang sku la byug pa 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// zhes brjod nas khrus chu bum par blugs nas tshe 'das kyi dri rten nam/ ming yig gang rung de la me long bstan te/ sngags kyi tshe khrus byed pa dang bcas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dzā sa mut+ga te swā hā/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/

sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du khrims 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du khong khro'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du le lo'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rnam g.yeng gi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du shes 'chal gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod cing bkrus la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom po// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas byin gyis brlabs te tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song= /de bzhin du/ chu 'di dug gi pha= /chu 'di dug gi ma= /bden pa'i= /dug gsum chu= /me 'di dug gi pha= /me 'di dug gi ma= /bden pa'i bden tshig= /dug gsum me= /rlung 'di dug gi pha= /rlung 'di dug gi ma= /bden pa'i= /dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs kyis bkrus la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i nyon mongs rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig

ces brjod nas dri rten nam ming yig la bum chu dang me tog 'thor zhing dril bu gsil ba dang bcas pas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad phyir// chos rnams ma lus ston mdzad des// khyed la= /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs= /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs= /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des= /khyed la= /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum mdzad// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la= /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la= /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la= /byang chub snying por gshegs pa ni// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la= /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la= /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig

/rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtsor byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las byung ba kho na yin zhing rgyud nas byung ba lta bu ni min no// de nas bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang 'dzin du bcug cing phyag byed du bcug la/ gtso bor rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa rnams sel bar// bdag ni skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jig pa sel mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi pa dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

brgyud ldan bla ma thugs rje can dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das sman bla bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pas brjod/ zas gtad byed pa ni/ sha chang la sogs pa dang ma 'dres pa'i dkar mngar gyi kha zas dang*/ ja 'o sogs btung ba dar zab la sogs pa bshams la chab bran/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang rig sngags kyi stobs kyis bshams pa'i rdzas 'di dag 'dod pa'i yon tan zad mi shes pa/ tshe las 'das pa'i dbang po'i spyod yul du ci 'dod pa 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun gyis spyir bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la= /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la= /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan bzhi brjod pas sgrib pa dang bral bar byas la/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong gzugs mdzes ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs te dmigs yul khyod la sbyin// bzhes shig gzugs kyi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// blo yis blangs te dmigs yul khyod la sbyin// bzhes shig sgra yi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshims byed dri// blo yis blangs te dmigs yul khyod la sbyin// bzhes shig dri yi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs te dmigs yul khyod la sbyin// bzhes shig ro yi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs te dmigs yul khyod la sbyin// bzhes gshegs reg bya'i 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ spar+she kā ma gu ṇa āḥhūm̐/ zhes tshigs su bcad pas 'dod yon so sor bsngos la/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod chad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /kha zas bstabs pa 'di yi mthus// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag thams cad zhi// bar do rang ngo 'phrod gyur te// dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar shog /ces smon lam bya'o// de nas lam bstan pa ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na saṃ bha wa/ rat+na ki ra ṇe/ rat+na mā la shud+dhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de shar phyogs bai ḍūr+ya'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i thugs kar 'phos par gyur/

pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// sman bla'i zhing du skye bar shog /rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma uta bha we ma hā a bhi nan+taṃ gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod la lta bas rgyas gdab/ byang bu bsreg pa ni/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gong bzhin sman bla'i gzungs brjod cing bsreg

thal ba chur dor ram swāts+tsha btab kyang rung ngam snyam/ mchan/ gshin chog gi dus bsngo smon 'dir bya srol 'dug pas de ltar byed na/ bsngo ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ bzang spyod/ bde smon/ byams smon/ phar phyin smon lam sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bton la 'khor gsum dmigs pa dang bral bas rgyas gdab/ rjes kyi mjug chog gtang rag gi phyag mchod 'bul ba man chad gzhung chog bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa'i bar bya zhing*/ ༈ gzhan yang 'di'i sgo nas sbyin bdag gi sdig sbyong gson dgung zhe dgu lta bu bzung dgos na/ dus rgyun mdo chog snying po gzhan phan bde 'jug ltar nyams su blangs pas don 'grub cing*/ bdun mtshams lta bur sbyin bdag la sdig sbyong dgos na/ cho ga phal cher gong gi gshin chog ltar byas nas sbyin bdag rnams mdun du 'khod du bcug la/ de la thog mar sman bla'i gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod de/ gong gi gshin chog skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab pa man chad gong ltar brjod cing shi gson gyi khyad par tshe 'das zhes yod pa rnams la tshe dang ldan pa zhes tshig bsgyur ba sogs khyad chos rnams rigs pas dpyad de mthar/ sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod pa'i bar 'dra zhing*/ de nas sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ yig bzung nas/ stong nyid ye shes sogs/ 'bar gyur cig bar lan gsum dang mthar/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs sman bla'i gzungs sngags brjod nas bsreg cing lta bas rgyas gdab/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo'i cho ga las ji ltar byung ba bzhin sdig sbyong gi rim pa rnams phul grub pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas kyang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba bsngos te bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su btang*/ rjes mjug cho ga gtang rag gi phyag mchod 'bul ba man gzhung bzhin bya'o// su zhig bsten pas mchog gi gnas thob cing*// cung zad dran pas phan bde'i dpal kun sbyin// thos pa tsam gyis sgrib tshogs sbyong mdzad pa// bde gshegs sman gyi bla ma mched brgyad kyi// mtshan dang gzungs sngags la brten rang dang gzhan// rnam kun rtag brtan 'gyur med zhi bde yi// dpal dang 'byor pa thob byed mdo chog gi /nyer mkho'i zur rgyan bdag dang skal mnyam rnams// 'jug pa bde phyir 'di bris dge ba'i tshogs// nyin byed dbang pos skye dgu'i mun bcom nas// don ldan bde gnyis shing rta la chibs te// zhi bde'i grong khyer chen po thob gyur cig /ces sman bla'i mdo chog la nyer mkho'i zur rgyan kun phan ut+pal gzhon nu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan gcig pur gyur pa kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong dpal bzang pos sman bla'i mdo chog gzhan phan bde 'jug gi zur 'debs gzhan phan nyer mkho zhes bya ba zhig mdzad 'dug kyang*/ spyir khams phyogs su zur 'debs 'di'i lung rgyun dkon pa dang*/ khyad par tshig gsal med pa rnams bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i don gnyer rnams rnam rtog gi mun lam du 'khyar ba'i gzhir gyur pa la brten/ bstan pa rin po cher lhag bsam gyi 'dun pa rnam par dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tsho byed bkra shis bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son zhing chos dang chos min pa rnam par 'byed pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan khu dbon brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi gral mthar 'khod pa shākya'i dge sbyong ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan nam/

ngag dbang blo gros dri med gzhan la phan pa mi zad pa'i gter zhes bgyi bas gong gsal gzhung tshig dkyus su zur 'debs bcug ste gung bsgrigs cung zad gsal kha dgos pa rnams dang bcas sa 'brug snron zla ba'i dmar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la grub par sbyar bas 'di la nyes gang gi tshogs ci mchis pa mkhas pa'i spyan sngar bshags shing bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ ༈ /sman chog gzhan phan bde 'jug dang 'brel bar stong mchod bya tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sman bla stong mchod dang khri mchod sogs kyi phyag bzhes sngon gyi dus su dpal snar thang pa sogs la shin tu dar zhing*/ deng skabs dge phyogs sogs nas phyag bzhes mdzad po ci rigs mchis pa don tu tshogs bsag pa'i phyir du mchod pa dang cho ga 'gro gang che mdzad pa tsam las/ rnam rgyal stong mchod bzhin du rgya gzhung gis zin pa'i phyag len spar bkab can ma yin pas so so'i 'byor pa dang brtson 'grus la dpag pa'i gang lcogs bya chog cing*/ de'ang brtson 'grus dang 'byor pa rab rnams kyis/ sman bla mched bdun gyi sku gzugs dang bcas pa'i pho brang bzhengs/ sku gzugs re re la tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun re/ mar me bdun re/ me tog spos sogs mchod pa rgyas pa bshams shing cho ga sngon dngos rjes gsum tshang bar btang ba la gcig tu brtsis pa brgya stong phrag la sogs pa'i bar du 'gro bar bya ba ni ches mchog tu gyur pa yin mod kyang*/ stong mchod 'dod la 'byor brtson dman pa dag gis bshams bkod spyir gzhung ltar la/ bye brag mar me gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod pa rnams re re zhing stong phrag re bsham/ go yul dang snod sogs ma 'grigs na tshar re bzhin brje ba'am/ bcu re'am brgya rtsa re bshams nas cho ga de'i grangs mnyam song ba'i mtshams su lan re brje/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun la 'dzom na mar me bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu/

ma 'dzom na'ang bdun ni stong mchod la mi brtsi bar zur du rgyun 'bar bya dgos so// cho ga thog mar rgyas pa tshar gcig gi gzungs sngags bzla ba yan grub nas/ tshar rjes ma rnams la mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags lan gsum brjod pas byin brlab/ ji snyed su dag sogs tshang bar brjod pas spyir bsags sbyang bya/ bye brag tu/ thugs dam bskul zhing mtshan gyi phyag mchod/ bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa chen po dgongs su gsol nas/ 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dang*/ mtshan legs kyi phyag mchod tshig lhug de brjod/ mchod pa kun 'bul sogs sh+lo ka gcig bcom ldan mtshan legs yongs bsgrags rgyal po yis// sngon tshe smon lam rnam brgyad sogs sh+lo ka gnyis brjod/ des sman bla'i bar du 'gre/ shāka thub la tshig lhug phyag mchod/ mchod pa kun 'bul sogs/ bcom ldan mnyam med sogs sh+lo ka gnyis/ chos la/ ma rig mun sel sogs/ mchod pa kun 'bul sogs dang*/ dam pa'i chos la sogs sh+lo ka re re/ 'jam dpal la phyag mchod tshig lhug mchod pa kun 'bul sogs dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs sh+lo ka re re/ skyabs grol la de dang mtshungs/ phyag rdor dang tshangs sogs phyag mchod tshig lhug mchod pa kun 'bul man chad gzhung ltar/ gnod sbyin sde dpon phyag mchod tshig lhug mchod pa kun 'bul man chad gzhung bzhin brjod la gzungs sngags che chung rnams gang 'grub re bzlas pas tshar gcig grub/ slar mchod sprin gzungs brjod pa nas/ gzungs sngags bzla ba yan ci 'grub byas la stong rtsa tshang ba'am/ nyin grangs mang po byed na dgongs mo bzhag ran pa dang khrus gsol nas shis brjod bar rjes chog tshar gcig gis 'thus so// skabs 'dir phyag mchod tshig lhug rnams mkhan po'i gzhung dngos yin pas dgos gal shin tu che zhing*/ de bzhin tu rjes chog skabs su 'byung ba'i/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la sogs mchod pa man gyi yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang mkhan po'i gzhung yin pas grub mtha' gzhan rnams kyis 'di kho na gsungs srol yod kyang*/

skabs 'dir stag lo'i gsung*/ mchod pa kun 'bul sogs tshigs bcad bkod par mdzad pa 'dir yang shin tu bsdu dgos pa'i skabs stabs bde ba la bsam pa yin pas cung zad spro na tshig lhug nyid so sor sbyar na legs so// phyag mchod grangs ka'ang gzhung ltar 'grub dgos pa yin kyang*/ ༈ stong mchod 'phral gsog dgos pa lta bur mi 'grub na/ sangs rgyas drug dang shāka thub bcas la gsum re/ sman bla la bdun/ 'jam dpal man chad re re bya/ de bzhin du gzungs chen tshar gcig gzungs thung bdun yan gang 'grub re bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang drung 'tsho ba maṅga la bha dra'i thugs bzhed ngor blo gros mtha' yas kyis spel ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /bde gshegs sman bla mched brgyad mchod pa'i cho ga'i phan yon mdor bsdus rna ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ngo mtshar thugs bskyed smon lam mthar phyin nas// dag pa'i zhing na da ltar 'tsho gzhes pa'i// bde gshegs bdun dang ston pa bka' drin can// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag byas te// blo dman spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir// sman bla'i cho ga btang ba yi// phan yon khungs dang 'brel ba ni// phyogs tsam bkod 'dir yid ches 'tshal// de'ang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku rim du mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos gtsug tor dri med dang sman bla'i mdo chog rnams mdzad/ bod du cho ga yongs grags dar ba'i thog ma ni 'di gnyis yin cing chos rgyal chen pos tshes brgyad byung ngo cog la sman bla'i cho ga btsugs pas rgyal po sku tshe dang bsod nams 'phel/ dam chos dar zhing rgyas/ bod khams mtha' dbus thams cad lo legs shing mi nad phyugs nad med pas bde skyid mnga' thang lha dang mnyam pa byung*/ sras mu tig btsan po nas bzung chos rgyal gdung brgyud rim byon rnams/ mnga' ris dgra bcom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags sogs snar thang mkhan chen rim byon rnams kyis thugs dam mdzad pas sku tshe ring zhing bsams tshad 'grub/

mthar sman bla'i zhing khams su gshegs pa sogs dngos grub ma thob pa gcig kyang ma byung*/ jo bo rje chen po'i yang thugs dam gyi rtsa ba yin pa dang*/ sngags chog rnams ni dbang dang dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin tshad ldan med na phan gnod ci 'gyur nges pa med la/ 'di ni dad mos yod na so skye tha mal pas kyang nyams su lon pa'i chos khe che la nyen chung ba dang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha lhag par che ba yin pas bka' gdams pa kun gyis sman chog dang gnas chog gnyis pa gtso bor mdzad/ rgyu mtshan des bod chos 'khor rnam gsum gtsos chos sde yongs grags kun la cho ga btang rgyu gtso bo sman chog 'di nyid yin cing*/ mkhan po sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas pa des sman chog kho na rtsal du bton pa'i don kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i dus su mdo rgyud spyi dang khyad par gzungs sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs byin rlabs chung du 'gro bar bshad la/ mdo 'di ni lnga brgya pa'i tha ma dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa byung ba na sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ mya ngan sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses shing phongs par gyur pa'i snyigs ma'i sems can la ched du dgongs te gsungs pas/ deng sang gi dus su byin rlabs nus pa cher 'gro ba la dgongs pa yin pas da lta'i skabs su mchog dman thams cad la nges par phan thogs pa'i zab mo'i chos khyad par du 'phags par grub bo// de lta bu'i cho ga khungs btsun de'i phan yon cung zad smos na spyi dang bye brag gnyis so// de la spyir dkon mchog gsum po dngos dang de dag gi rten la dad pas mchod pa'i phan yon tshad med de/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum dag na bde zhing skyid pa// thams cad dkon mchog mchod las byung ba// des na bde zhing skyid par 'dod pas// dkon mchog gsum po mchod la brtson bya// zhes gsungs shing dkon mchog gsum po'ang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur tshad med pa byas pa las sangs rgyas la dmigs te me tog gcig nam mkhar dor ba phan yon che ste/

mdo las/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dgra bcom pa bye ba phrag brgya la lo mang du bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la dang ba'i sems kyis yud tsam zhig mig gis bltas pa bsod nams che bar gsungs shing*/ bram ze zhig gis lam khar de bzhin gshegs par tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa chen po nyi shu'i bar du ngan song gi sgo khegs par gsungs/ sangs rgyas la bskal pa dpag tu med par mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pa las kyang theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos la yud tsam zhig thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'am glegs bam 'dri ba tsam yang bsod nams che bar gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa la mchod pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'am zhing khams gzhan du bzhugs pa la mchod pas phan yon che chung khyad par cung zad kyang med pa ma zad bstan 'jig la nye ba'i dus ngan 'di lta bu'i skabs sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs rgyal bas bsngags pa'i bslab pa sna gcig la nyin zhag gcig bslabs na phan yon snga ma las kyang che ste/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa las/ gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon sum du me tog dang spos dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang na bza' dang rgyan rnams kyi mchod pas mchod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha'i bu dag gang sems can la las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya stong ngam bskal pa bye ba lon kyang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes mtshan nas lan bdun brjod nas nam mkha' la me tog gtor na de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par 'gyur ro// me tog nam mkhar gtor ba lta zhog gi gang dag dad pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su slob pa la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bslab pa gcig tsam 'dzin nam/ nyin gcig gam mtshan gcig gam/

yud tsam zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa yid la byed par brtson na de sdug bsngal mthar byas nas rim gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gags par 'gyur ba'i tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa// bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs so// mchod chog gi gtso bo yan lag bdun pa yin cing*/ de las phyag 'tshal ba kho na la'ang phan yon mtha' yas pa yod pa dang*/ de las dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa 'bul ba tshogs che/ de las sdig pa bshags pa bsod nams kyi stobs che ba sogs phyi ma rnams rim pa bzhin phan yon che bar gsungs pas bsam pa rnam par dag pas sman chog tshad ldan tshar gcig byas na bskal pa grangs med pa'i las kyi sgrib pa byang*/ bskal pa chen po 'di chags nas ma zhig gi bar du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa dang bsod nams mnyam mo// bye brag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs yongs bsgrags kyi mtshan bzung zhing phyag byas pas/ nad gdon byad ka thams cad las grol/ 'on long smyo ba sogs las thar/ dam pa'i chos spong zhing mtshams med sogs sdig pa tshabs chen pos dmyal bar song na'ang mtshan yid la dran pas thar zhing phyin chad der mi skye/ dbul po phyug por 'gyur/ btson ra rdeg rdung gcan gzan 'thab rtsod chu bo'i 'jigs pa sogs las skyob par 'gyur ro// bde gshegs rin chen zla ba la phyag byas pas/ byang chub kyi sems dang dge ba'i chos 'phel zhing legs pa'i bsam don thams cad 'grub/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal las thar/ bud med kyi skye sgo chod/ 'chi byed kyi gnod pa dang mya ngan sdug bsngal mtshan mo'i gdon la sogs pa zhi/ dran pa ting 'dzin gzungs kyi sgo sogs mngon tu 'gyur/ nyan rang gi lam du mi gol zhing byang chub las phyir mi ldog

bskal pa mes 'jig pa'i tshe sdug bsngal mi myong bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro// gser bzang dri med la phyag byas pas/ tshe thung ba'i sgrib pa byang nas tshe ring zhing nad dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bas mi tshugs/ dbul por skye ba'i las sgrib byang nas dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ 'thab rtsod byed pa rnams kyi gnod sems zhi nas byams pa la gnas/ tshul khrims 'chal bas ngan 'gror skye ba'i las sgrib byang nas tshul khrims rnam par dag cing byang chub kyi sems skye/ 'di'i gzungs sngags la'ang phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs so// mya ngan med dpal la phyag byas pas/ mya ngan sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing tshe ring*/ dmyal ba mun nag las thar/ dbul phongs zhi nas 'byor pa chen po thob/ gnod sbyin srin po sogs gdon gyis mi tshugs/ nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// chos bsgrags rgya mtsho la phyag byas pas log lta'i sgrib pa dag nas yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra mi grags pa'i mtha' 'khob kyi sems can ngan song du 'gro ba las thar/ longs spyod gsos sman sogs bsam pa tsam gyis 'byor/ 'thab rtsod byed pa la byams pa'i sems skye nas rang gi 'byor pas chog shes par 'gyur ro// mngon mkhyen rgyal po la phyag byas pas/ tshong dang zhing las sdig pa'i las byed pa rnams kyi sdig pa'i sems zhi nas mkho dgus 'byor/ mi dge bcu byed pa las ldog nas dge bcu dang ldan/ rgyal po'i chad pa sna tshogs las thar/ sdig pa'i 'bras bus 'chi ba rnams mtshan thos nas bde 'gro mtho ris su skyes te sdig pa'i rnam smin byang bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma la phyag byas pas/ tshul khrims nyams par mi 'gyur/ dbang po yan lag skyon med cing nad dang gnod pa thams cad las grol/ bud med kyi skye gnas las thar/ btson bcing rdeg gsod sogs rgyal po'i chad pa las skyob/

ser snas yi dwags su skyes pa dang*/ tshul khrims mchog 'dzin dang mang du thos pa'i nga rgyal gyis dmyal bar skyes pa dang*/ phrag dog gis bdag bstod gzhan la smod pas ngan song gsum du skyes pa rnams kyang sngon mir skyes pa'i skabs sman bla'i mtshan thos pa'i dge rtsa sad nas myur du de las thar zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa can tu 'gyur/ byad ka rbod gtong gang gis kyang mi tshugs/ 'chi ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' brgyad byon nas bde ba can du lam sna 'dren/ yang na lha dang mi'i dbang phyug khyad par can du skye bar 'gyur ro// nyin zhag bdun du bsnyen gnas bsrungs te cho ga 'don cing sku gzugs la mchod pa dang bskor ba byas na tshe ring ba dang*/ longs spyod dpal 'byor rigs brgyud 'phel ba dang*/ ltas dang rmi lam ngan pa me chu dug mtshon dmag dang dgra rkun gcan gzan sogs 'jigs pa thams cad zhi/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba mi 'byung*/ tshul khrims nyams pa rnams kyang ngan song du mi 'gro/ bud med btsa' ba'i skabs su nad mi 'byung zhing khye'u bde bar 'tsho ba dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i mtshan rna lam du thos pa tsam gyis ngan song du 'gro mi srid par gsungs so// rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag byas pas bskal chen brgyad khri'i sdig pa byang zhing snying rje chen po'i sems 'grub pa dang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro// spyir de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi mtshan bzung ba dang mchod cing phyag byas pas/ sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su zad cing byang*/ nad dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad zhi zhing tshe ring por 'gyur/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rim gyis srab/ bdud sdig can gyis gnod mi nus shing 'thab rtsod 'khrugs pa zhi/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab/

'chi ba'i tshe na'ang de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs shing so so'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas de ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams mngon tu 'gyur/ byang chub ma thob par du nam yang ngan 'gro log par ltung bar mi 'gro zhing skye ba dran pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'phrad par 'gyur ba dang*/ der ma zad sangs rgyas 'di rnams kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur bar gsungs so// bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi gzungs bklags pas mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i las kyi sgrib pa byang zhing nad gdon gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rang dbang thob cing bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas dgongs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa lha dang bcas pas srung zhing skyob pa dang*/ gzungs sngags gzhan rnams la'ang phan yon dpag tu med pa 'thob par bshad do// mdo 'di 'dzin pa la phyag na rdo rje dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis g.yog bdun 'bum dang bcas pa rnams kyi srung zhing bskyang ba dang*/ gnod pa las thar zhing bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar dam bcas pa yin la/ rgyal khams su nad yams dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung po la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang*/ than pa rlung dmar char ches pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung ba'i tshe rgyal po des sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems kyis 'di'i cho ga byed cing btson tu bzung ba btang na gnod pa zhi zhing yul khams bde zhing bkra shis la rgyal srid dpal 'byor 'phel bar gsungs te/ de'ang bshad pa tsam ma yin par mngon sum du gyur pa ni gong smos lo rgyus kyis shes so// gzungs khrus/ byang chog 'chi bslu rnams la'ang byin rlabs dang yon tan khyad par can du 'byung ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung nam yang mi bslu bas gong smos rnams kyi dngos dang shugs las rtogs so// sangs rgyas yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' 'dra ste// de mnyes byas pa'i bsod nams de bas lhag

/de la nam yang tshad bzung nus min kyang*// cung zad brjod 'dis phyogs tsam mtshon par byed// 'dis kyang mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro// dad pa'i pad+mo rab bzhad de// rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i snang chen po// 'jug pa'i skal pa bzang ldan shog /ces pa 'di ni mkhyen dpyod dge ba'i dpal gyis 'byor pa 'tsho mdzad bkra shis bzang po'i thugs bzhed ltar blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben khrod du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
